summary: CFC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement dated October 16, 2026 for up to an unspecified amount of Series 2026 member capital securities offered directly to its voting members who are existing CFC security holders. Each security matures 30 years from issuance, pays interest semi-annually on April 1 and October 1, and carries a $25,000 minimum denomination. The securities are unsecured, subordinated to senior indebtedness and to subordinated debt transferable to non-members, ranking pari passu with existing member subordinated certificates and prior member capital securities. Transfer requires CFC's written consent; no exchange listing. Watch pricing supplement terms, redemption features and member take-up.
